decisions.reason: As a flagship seasonal product with repeated gold-award recognition and a very close fit to the firm's established stollen and confectionery know-how, it is highly likely to be retained and further exploited commercially.

This rye-based bread sits close to the bakery's core bread knowledge and, since it remained actively presented after launch while other breads were removed, management would likely see enough learning and fit to keep it on the market.

Marzipan Christmas stollen builds directly on the firm's traditional seasonal pastry capabilities and ingredient knowledge, so the firm is well positioned to refine and market it rather than withdraw it.
